description: Read the workspace's activity log, newest first: who changed what and when, and how (in the web app, with an API key, or by nopaque staff). Covers API keys, members and roles, billing, tests and their schedules, load tests, batches, sweeps, mapping jobs, imports, phone numbers and caller ID, alert rules and destinations. Filters: category (access, keys, billing, workspace, testing, numbers, assistant), action (e.g. api_key.created), actor (a user id or API key id), target (type:id, e.g. test:<id>), from/to (dates), limit (at most 100) and cursor (nextCursor from the previous page, sent with from = the previous window.from). Use cases: "who changed our API keys last week" (category keys), "who deleted that test" (target test:<id>), "what did this key do" (actor <key id>). Entries hold ids, not names: name a test with getTestConfig or getMissionTestConfig. nopaque staff show with no id. Only entries inside the plan's window (window in the response) are returned. Needs an Enterprise workspace and an API key created by an owner or admin with the audit:read scope by name; a key with full access (*) or with no scopes is refused (403), and a key made by a billing admin reads only the billing category. Every call through this server counts as a call with an API key. Read-only.

actor.description: Only actions by this user id or API key id.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page. Send `from` = the previous `window.from` with it.

from.description: Start of the range. Earlier than the plan's window counts as the window's start.

target.description: Only actions on this record, as `type:id`, e.g. `test:3f2a...`.

to.description: End of the range. A date alone means the whole of that day.

name: listAuditEvents

items.description:
One action in the activity log. Entries hold ids, never names: look a person up by
their user id, a key by its id. A nopaque staff actor has no `id`, and neither does a
target that is a member of nopaque staff.

id.description: A user id, an API key id, or a system name. Absent for nopaque staff.

details.description:
A few fields that depend on the action: ids, values from a fixed list, counts and
booleans (and lists of codes). Never free text.

finishedAt.description: When the result arrived. Absent while pending or not recorded.

id.description: The record's id. Never a phone number or an email address.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor`, with `from` set to `window.from`, for the next page.

window.description: How far back the workspace's plan shows the log.

windowApplied.description: True when the plan's window set the start of the range.

title: Read the Activity Log
